'''Rawwks''' were [[Mammavian/Legends|mammavians]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. They inhabited the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant's]] upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], hunting other airborne creatures with a screech that disoriented their prey. That distinctive screech gave them their name. They often nested in abandoned prospecting stations floating in Bespin's atmosphere.

A large colony of rawwks that inhabited [[Tibannopolis]] formed an [[Animal bond|empathic connection]] with future [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Streen]]; when he left Bespin, the entire flock, numbering in the thousands, took to the air in a farewell gesture.

Rawwks also created nests on top of [[Beldon/Legends|beldons]]. It was a symbiotic relationship: the Rawwks had a place to live, and served as a warning system for approaching [[Velker/Legends|velkers]].
